newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian shares drop as rally loses steam.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian shares drop as rally loses steam.

text.p: Shares on Jordan's stock exchange shed 0.34 percent on Sunday as a week-long rally triggered by outside buying petered out, dealers said.
The official Amman Financial Market (AFM) index fell 0.54 points to close at 157.13 points, losing some of the market's recent gains which sent stocks to 14-month highs last week.
Prices have risen steadily after parliament abolished two weeks ago a punitive 15 percent tax on companies who raise capital with transfers from reserves.
"There was a drop on the stock that rose yesterday...the foreign buying has petered out," said Husam al-Hanbali, head of the brokerage arm of Jordan's Arab Banking Corporation.

Two leading drug firms which sharply rose on Saturday with strong outside buying lost ground. Arab Pharmaceutical Chemicals shed 0.01 dinars to 1.60 dinars in trade worth 68,516 dinars. Arab Pharmaceutical Manufacturing fell 0.05 dinars to 3.89 dinars in low 26,339 dinars turnover.
Heavily weighted Arab Bank fell 1.50 dinars to 262 dinars, helping to drag the market lower.
Overall shares in 25 companies fell, 11 rose, and four traded but closed unchanged. The private Pearl Index shed 0.19 percent to 83.25 points.
